full_prompt_en: A square figurative oil painting shows a young man and woman seated close together against a weathered peach-and-brown interior wall. The background is built from broad scraped rectangles and irregular patches of umber, rust, and warm cream. These marks suggest a room without clearly defining its furnishings, leaving the figures as the only fully resolved elements. The man sits on the left, leaning forward in a pale rolled-sleeve shirt, dark narrow tie, and muted blue trousers. His dark hair is tousled, and his face angles down toward the woman. One hand rests near his mouth; the other reaches toward his knee, where a small pale object is partly visible. To the right, the woman sits higher on a dark bench or ledge in a short black dress. Her light hair is gathered loosely at the back, with soft strands around the face. She also leans inward, propping her chin on one hand as she looks down toward the man. Her legs cross prominently in the lower center, with black shoes defining the ends of the long pale diagonal shapes. A horizontal brown band runs behind their seats and anchors the pair within the otherwise broken background. Dark patches beneath the bench and along the lower edge make the figures appear suspended slightly above the warm floor. Light falls softly from the upper left, brightening the woman's face, arms, and legs and the man's shirt, while their dark clothing creates a compact central shadow. Painterly edges alternate between clear flesh contours and dissolving brush marks, with thin drips visible below the background color blocks. No readable text appears. The overall composition is intimate and subdued, using close body language, scraped warm surfaces, and a few near-black accents to suggest a private moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形人物油画呈现一位年轻男子和女子并坐在斑驳的桃色与棕色室内墙前。背景由大片刮擦矩形和不规则的赭褐、锈红及暖乳色斑块组成。这些笔痕暗示房间，却没有清楚界定家具，使人物成为唯一充分成形的元素。男子坐在左侧，身体前倾，穿卷袖浅色衬衫、深色窄领带和低饱和蓝色长裤。深色头发有些凌乱，面孔向下转向女子。一只手停在嘴边，另一只手伸向膝部，那里可见一点浅色小物。右侧女子坐在一条深色长凳或台沿上，比男子稍高，穿短黑裙。浅色头发松松束在脑后，脸旁留有柔软发丝。她也向内倾身，单手托下巴，低头看向男子。交叠的双腿在画面下部中央形成醒目形体，黑鞋收束长而浅的斜线。横向棕色带从座位后方经过，把两人固定在其余破碎的背景之中。长凳下和下缘的深色斑块让两人显得略高于暖色地面。柔光从左上方落下，照亮女子的面庞、手臂和双腿，以及男子的衬衣，深色衣着则形成紧凑的中央阴影。绘画边缘在清晰的肤色轮廓与逐渐溶解的笔痕之间交替，背景色块下方可见细细流痕。画面没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而含蓄，用靠近的肢体、刮擦过的暖色表面和少量近黑重音暗示一个私密时刻。
style_prompt_en: The figurative oil painting places relatively clear, softly modeled focal forms against a loose ground of scraped, layered color blocks. Warm peach, rust brown, cream, and umber dominate, while muted cool notes and near-black accents hold the eye in the center. Broad dry-brush swipes, exposed underpainting, and occasional vertical drips make the surface feel worked and revised. Edges alternate between precise contours at key transitions and open, broken boundaries that merge into the ground. The lighting is gentle and directional, concentrating warm illumination on selected planes while allowing dark forms to compress into a central cluster. Horizontal background bands provide a stable seat for diagonals and curves in front, keeping the arrangement balanced without polished architectural detail. Smooth passages of color gain force because they are surrounded by abrasive texture. The overall effect is intimate, slightly melancholy, and contemporary, with painterly incompleteness acting as a deliberate part of the composition.
style_prompt_zh: 这种人物油画把相对清晰、柔和塑形的焦点形体放在刮擦、层叠色块构成的松散背景前。暖桃色、锈棕、乳白和赭褐占主导，低饱和冷色和近黑重音把视线留在中央。宽阔干刷、露出的底层颜料以及偶尔的竖向流痕，让表面显得经历过反复加工和修改。边缘在关键转折处的精确轮廓与融入背景的开放破碎边界之间交替。光线柔和且有方向性，把暖色照明集中在选择性的色面，同时让深色形体压缩成中央的一组。横向背景色带为前方斜线与曲线提供稳定支点，使安排保持平衡，却不依赖精致的建筑细节。平滑色彩段落因为周围粗涩肌理而获得力量。整体效果亲密、略带忧郁且具有当代感，绘画上的未完成感成为刻意的构图部分。
theme_en: Two young adults seated together in a weathered warm-toned interior
theme_zh: 两位年轻人并坐在斑驳暖色室内
name: Michael Carson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
